Analysis of BabyView on SVO Probes dataset in the 4AFC format

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
data <- read_csv("verb_data/svo_verb_4afc_scores.csv")

fc.accuracy <- data %>%
  mutate(correct = ifelse(correct==TRUE, 1, 0)) %>%
  group_by(target_lemma) %>%
  summarize(average = mean(correct), num_d = length(correct))
```

```{r}
library(patchwork)

plot_data <- fc.accuracy %>%
  arrange(desc(average), target_lemma) %>%
  mutate(target_lemma = factor(target_lemma, levels = target_lemma))

mean_accuracy <- mean(plot_data$average, na.rm = TRUE)

references <- tibble(
  y = c(0.25, mean_accuracy),
  label = c("Chance (25%)", sprintf("Mean across verbs (%.1f%%)", 100 * mean_accuracy))
)

accuracy_plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(target_lemma, average)) +
  geom_hline(
    data = references,
    aes(yintercept = y, colour = label),
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, colour = "#2166AC") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("grey45", "#B35806")) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
    labels = scales::label_percent()
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "4AFC accuracy", colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top", axis.text.x = element_blank())

# include the number of data points for each figure
figure <- accuracy_plot +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = setNames(
      paste0(plot_data$target_lemma, "\n(n = ", plot_data$num_d, ")"),
      plot_data$target_lemma
    )
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, size = 8, lineheight = 0.95),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(
  "verb_figures/svo_4afc_accuracy_by_verb.pdf",
  figure, width = 16, height = 5, dpi = 300
)

figure
```
